ItemID: NA; Title: The Breeze: An Appreciation of JJ Cale; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Old Sock makes this a natural next listen; I would choose it for more Clapton and relaxed blues.
ItemID: NA; Title: An American Treasure Deluxe; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Tom Petty fits my roots-rock interests, but I would save this larger collection for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Blue & Lonesome; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The Stones playing blues appeals to my interest in the blues side of Hendrix and Clapton; I would try this.
ItemID: NA; Title: From A Room: Volume 2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its country and roots sound could fit my interest in Blown Away, but it is not my first choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: A New Day Yesterday; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Blues guitar fits my recent listening, though I would start with the more familiar Clapton release.
ItemID: NA; Title: Ultimate Sinatra: 100 Songs Celebrating 100 Years; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven blues, rock, or country rather than a large vocal standards collection.
ItemID: NA; Title: 3 Pears; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Country with a roots-rock edge sounds relevant, but I am only choosing a couple of albums today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Retrospective; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone does not tell me whose music this is, so I lack a reason to choose it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Don Henley Cass County; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Henley's country direction sounds compatible with my recent country and roots listening, but I would save it for later.
ItemID: NA; Title: Made Up Mind; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its blues and soul direction appeals alongside Memphis and Old Sock, but my choices today already cover that mood.
